title: Gang Retaliation Attack Kills at Least 11 After Security Operation
detail: A gang retaliation attack killed at least 11 people following a Haitian government security operation. The violence underscores the persistent cycle of gang reprisals against communities where security forces have conducted operations.

media.caption: Gang retaliation attack kills at least 11 in Haiti following security operation

title: UN Security Council Extends Gang Suppression Force Mandate to March 2027
detail: The UN Security Council voted 12-0 with three abstentions (China, Pakistan, Russia) on Resolution 2829 to extend the Gang Suppression Force for six months, through March 31, 2027, and to continue UN Support Office (UNSOH) logistics. Around 1,500 GSF troops are deployed of the 5,500 authorized.

media.caption: UN extends Haiti's Gang Suppression Force mandate to March 2027
